change.after: "default exclusions for Endpoints, EndpointSlice, Lease, review kinds, CertificateSigningRequest, PolicyReport, CertificateRequest, Kyverno and Cilium kinds"

consequence.statement: Resources of the listed kinds are excluded from Argo CD by default, so they are no longer tracked or managed unless resource.exclusions is overridden or removed in the configMap.
consequence.remediation: Override or remove resource.exclusions in argocd-cm to preserve v2 behavior.

assertion.statement: The Argo CD manifest now ships a default resource.exclusions in argocd-cm that excludes high-churn controller-created kinds (Endpoints, EndpointSlice, Lease, Kyverno reports, Cilium identities, etc.); it can be overridden or removed to preserve v2 behavior.
